description: This source file provides authentication utility functions for sign-up, password reset, OAuth login, and error handling, utilizing the Supabase client library.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password, redirect URL configured.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Initiates password reset process via email.

methods.name: signInWithMagicLink
methods.description: Signs in user using email with OTP (magic link) pattern.

methods.name: signInWithOAuth
methods.description: Signs in user via OAuth provider, with redirect URL configuration.

methods.name: handleAuthError
methods.description: Logs authentication errors and navigates to error pages based on error message content.
